answer: Duplicating identities means posting a fresh bond per sybil, and slashing burns the stake plus the scarce wharf lease, so forging N agents costs N bonds with no recovery. Each agent must lock a unique pigment-tagged bond at a shared bridge wharf, verified on-chain prior to voting. Honest agents reclaim their pigment after the epoch, making mass fakery economically irrational. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
